money_representation: exact decimal strings, never floats, never exponent notation
timestamp_representation: ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset
canonical_naming_rule: One canonical name per concept. flow_adjusted_equity is THE name for broker equity net of external flows; adjusted_equity, performance_equity and normalized_equity are forbidden as aliases in backend, API and frontend alike.
terminology_warning: profit_reserve_* is ACCOUNTING ONLY and is not the EDA-1 cash reserve. The EDA-1 cash reserve is trading liquidity held back by the allocation policy (10% at target, 5% further to the hard cap) and it changes position sizing. The Profit Reserve changes nothing: it is a notional earmark against future withdrawal. No field in this contract is an input to any sizing, risk or trading decision.

fields.name: contract_version
fields.calculation: The frozen contract version. Bumping it is a deliberate act, never a side effect of an implementation change.

fields.name: generated_at
fields.calculation: When this payload was assembled. Not a data timestamp; see data_freshness.

fields.name: account_fingerprint
fields.calculation: SHA-256 of the broker account number, first 32 hex characters. Every field in this payload is scoped to this one account. A payload whose fingerprint does not match the pin must be discarded, not displayed.

fields.name: environment
fields.calculation: Always the literal LIVE. This contract describes the real-money book only; Paper has its own, separate accounting and is never aggregated into these figures.

fields.name: accounting_inception_at
fields.calculation: The instant the accounting baseline was frozen. Every 'since inception' figure is measured from here. NULL before inception is established, and in that state accounting_status is NOT_INITIALIZED and every derived money field is NULL.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC. Flows at exactly this instant are PRE_INCEPTION (the boundary is exclusive on the later side: a flow counts only if strictly after).

fields.name: baseline_equity
fields.authoritative_source: broker equity at the inception snapshot
fields.calculation: Opening CAPITAL. Not profit, and never re-counted as a deposit. Frozen once; a change requires an explicit documented rebuild.

fields.name: baseline_cash
fields.authoritative_source: broker cash at the inception snapshot
fields.calculation: Recorded for audit. No derived figure depends on it.

fields.name: current_broker_equity
fields.calculation: What the broker reported at the last checkpoint. NULL when the broker could not be read; accounting_status is then BROKER_UNAVAILABLE and no downstream figure is fabricated.

fields.name: current_cash
fields.calculation: Total cash the broker reports. On a cash account this includes unsettled sale proceeds and is NOT withdrawable cash.

fields.name: broker_withdrawable_cash
fields.calculation: Authoritatively withdrawable settled cash. This broker's Trading API exposes no such field, so this is ALWAYS NULL and broker_withdrawable_cash_status says why. It is never inferred from cash, buying_power or equity.

fields.name: broker_withdrawable_cash_status
fields.calculation: One of VERIFIED, NOT_EXPOSED_BY_BROKER, UNKNOWN. Today it is NOT_EXPOSED_BY_BROKER.

fields.name: confirmed_deposits
fields.calculation: Sum of confirmed external deposits with settle_at strictly after accounting_inception_at. Excludes the flow that delivered baseline_equity. Excludes anything pending, and anything classified UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_FLOW.

fields.name: confirmed_withdrawals
fields.calculation: Sum of confirmed external withdrawals since inception, as a POSITIVE magnitude.

fields.name: net_external_flows
fields.calculation: confirmed_deposits - confirmed_withdrawals. Signed: positive means capital was added on net.

fields.name: pending_flows_excluded_count
fields.calculation: How many broker activities were seen but are not yet confirmed under the accepted rule. They have ZERO accounting effect. Operator expectation is never a source.

fields.name: unknown_external_flow_count
fields.calculation: How many activities could not be classified safely. Any value above zero forces accounting_status = UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_FLOW and suppresses the reserve, bucket and preview figures. Fail closed.

fields.name: last_external_flow_at
fields.calculation: Settle time of the most recent CONFIRMED external flow since inception. NULL when there is none.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC, the broker's own transaction time.

fields.name: flow_adjusted_equity
fields.calculation: current_broker_equity - net_external_flows. THE canonical name for this concept. There is no adjusted_equity, performance_equity or normalized_equity anywhere in this system; a second name for this number is a defect.

fields.name: trading_pnl_since_inception
fields.calculation: flow_adjusted_equity - baseline_equity. Invariant: unchanged by any deposit and by any withdrawal.

fields.name: realized_pnl
fields.calculation: Net realized P&L since inception, from the authoritative weighted-average-cost ledger. This contract consumes that ledger; it does not reimplement it. NULL when the ledger is unreadable or its reconciliation verdict is not trustworthy.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl
fields.calculation: Mark-to-market on open positions. NULL when positions could not be read.

fields.name: realized_pnl_basis_status
fields.calculation: The realized ledger's own verdict, surfaced rather than hidden: CLEAN, BASIS_DIVERGENCE, DEGRADED, MISMATCH, UNKNOWN. BASIS_DIVERGENCE means the broker relieved different lots than the ledger did; realized_pnl is still a real number but its split against unrealized differs from the broker's.

fields.name: time_weighted_return
fields.calculation: Flow-neutral return since inception, as a ratio (0.06 means +6%). Sub-period returns are chained; each sub-period containing a confirmed flow is bounded conservatively. See twr_convention. External flows cannot mechanically move this figure.

fields.name: twr_convention
fields.calculation: Always CONSERVATIVE_MIN. For a sub-period from equity B to equity E containing net confirmed flow F, the sub-period return is min((E-F)/B - 1, E/(B+F) - 1): the lower of the flow-at-end and flow-at-start endpoint assumptions. With F=0 both limbs are equal and this is the ordinary return. With zero market movement both limbs are exactly zero, so a flow alone never moves TWR. The lower limb is taken because a deposit flatters the flow-at-end limb and a withdrawal flatters the flow-at-start limb, and this program refuses to be flattered by either.

fields.name: twr_subperiods
fields.calculation: How many sub-periods the chain was built from. One per interval between consecutive checkpoints.

fields.name: twr_bounded_subperiods
fields.calculation: How many of those sub-periods contained a confirmed flow and were therefore bounded rather than measured exactly. Zero means TWR is exact.

fields.name: adjusted_equity_hwm
fields.calculation: The maximum flow_adjusted_equity over AUTHORITATIVE completed-day checkpoints, floored at baseline_equity. Intraday prints never raise it. A deposit cannot raise it, because it is a maximum of a flow-adjusted quantity.

fields.name: adjusted_equity_hwm_at
fields.calculation: The completed-day checkpoint that set the current HWM.

fields.name: observed_intraday_peak
fields.calculation: The highest flow_adjusted_equity ever observed including intraday reads. INFORMATIONAL ONLY. No reserve, bucket or preview figure may be derived from it.

fields.name: current_drawdown_from_adjusted_hwm
fields.calculation: flow_adjusted_equity / adjusted_equity_hwm - 1. Zero or negative. Deposits and withdrawals can neither create nor erase it.

fields.name: profit_reserve_policy_id
fields.calculation: Always PROFIT_RESERVE_OBSERVE_V1 for the first month.

fields.name: profit_reserve_policy_hash
fields.authoritative_source: canonical JSON of the reserve policy
fields.calculation: Digest of the reserve policy parameter set. A changed rate changes this hash.

fields.name: profit_reserve_rate
fields.calculation: 0.20 — a PROVISIONAL first-month observation rate, not a permanent investment decision. Prompt 4 revisits it.

fields.name: new_hwm_profit
fields.authoritative_source: derived at the last authoritative checkpoint
fields.calculation: max(0, flow_adjusted_equity - prior reserve HWM) at the most recent completed-day checkpoint. Deposits do not increase it; withdrawals do not decrease it; only account performance above the prior HWM creates it.

fields.name: profit_reserve_accrued
fields.calculation: Lifetime sum of reserve accruals: profit_reserve_rate x new_hwm_profit at each new authoritative HWM. An ACCOUNTING ALLOCATION ONLY. No money moved and no broker cash was segregated.
fields.observe_only_semantics: Accrual continues under OBSERVE_ONLY. It confers no entitlement and triggers nothing.

fields.name: withdrawal_bucket_balance
fields.authoritative_source: derived from profit_reserve_events and allocated withdrawals
fields.calculation: prior bucket + accruals - withdrawals allocated against it. Floored at zero, never negative. A VIRTUAL ledger line: not a bank account, not broker-segregated cash, and it does not reduce trading capital.
fields.observe_only_semantics: Recorded but never actionable during OBSERVE_ONLY.

fields.name: unreserved_withdrawal_total
fields.calculation: Lifetime sum of the portion of confirmed withdrawals that exceeded the bucket at the time they settled. Flagged rather than absorbed: it means capital, not harvested profit, left the account.

fields.name: withdrawal_preview
fields.calculation: INFORMATIONAL. The bucket balance when harvest_eligible is true AND flow_adjusted_equity is at or above adjusted_equity_hwm; otherwise 0. Not a guaranteed broker-transferable amount, and explicitly not a claim that the broker would settle it.
fields.observe_only_semantics: Display only. It is never an instruction and never an authorization.

fields.name: harvest_eligible
fields.calculation: Whether a completed monthly checkpoint has occurred since the last harvest. Reserve accrual is continuous; harvest eligibility is monthly. This system produces no daily transfer recommendation.

fields.name: next_harvest_checkpoint_at
fields.calculation: The end of the current UTC month, which is the earliest instant harvest_eligible could next become true.

fields.name: withdrawal_authorized
fields.calculation: ALWAYS FALSE during the first-month validation.
fields.observe_only_semantics: Hard-coded false under OBSERVE_ONLY. Not a computed value that could become true.

fields.name: authorized_withdrawal_amount
fields.calculation: ALWAYS 0 during the first-month validation.

fields.name: withdrawal_mode
fields.calculation: Always OBSERVE_ONLY.
fields.observe_only_semantics: The only value this build can emit. No code path sets any other.

fields.name: automatic_transfer_enabled
fields.calculation: ALWAYS FALSE. No ACH, wire, transfer, scheduling or broker withdrawal call exists in this package, and the broker's Trading API exposes no transfer endpoint to call.

fields.name: last_accounting_checkpoint_at
fields.calculation: When the accounting layer last recorded broker truth.

fields.name: last_completed_day_checkpoint_at
fields.calculation: The most recent AUTHORITATIVE checkpoint. HWM, reserve and harvest all key off this, never off an intraday read.

fields.name: accounting_status
fields.calculation: One of NOT_INITIALIZED, CLEAN, STALE, UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_FLOW, REBUILD_REQUIRED, BROKER_UNAVAILABLE, ACCOUNT_MISMATCH. Anything other than CLEAN means the derived figures are suppressed to NULL rather than shown as precise wrong numbers.

fields.name: accounting_status_detail
fields.calculation: A sentence an operator can act on. NULL when status is CLEAN.

fields.name: data_freshness_seconds
fields.calculation: generated_at minus last_accounting_checkpoint_at. NULL before the first checkpoint.

fields.name: data_freshness
fields.calculation: FRESH, STALE or UNKNOWN. STALE past the staleness horizon; the horizon is stated in the contract document.

fields.name: rebuild_count
fields.calculation: How many times derived state has been deterministically rebuilt from the ledger, e.g. because a backdated flow arrived. A rebuild is recorded, never silent.

fields.name: last_rebuild_at
fields.calculation: When the last rebuild happened. NULL when there has never been one.

fields.name: live_ready
fields.calculation: Passed through from the Prompt-1 startup report. This package NEVER computes or influences it. NULL when the safety state could not be read.

fields.name: live_armed
fields.authoritative_source: Prompt-1 durable arm row and environment gate
fields.calculation: Passed through from the Prompt-1 arm state. This package NEVER computes, sets or clears it. NULL when it could not be read; a NULL is displayed as unknown, never as false.
